# Agent studios
Source: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/
Markdown: https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/index.md
Description: Register agents built in Agentforce, Copilot Studio, Dialogflow CX, Amazon Lex, and other agent studios in GGX for testing and governance.

Agent studios are platforms where teams build and host conversational AI agents. Connect one in **Org Settings → Integrations → Agent studios** and GGX can register those agents, so they are tested, evaluated, and governed like any other agent.

| Integration | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [Agentforce (Salesforce)](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/agentforce/) | Register autonomous Agentforce agents. |
| [Vertex AI Agent Playbooks](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/vertex-ai-agent-playbooks/) | Register Google Cloud playbook-based conversational agents. |
| [Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/microsoft-copilot-studio/) | Register low-code Copilot Studio agents. |
| [GitHub Copilot](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/github-copilot/) | Register GitHub Copilot chat as an agent. |
| [Vapi AI](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/vapi-ai/) | Register Vapi assistants as chat agents. |
| [Amazon Lex](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/amazon-lex/) | Register Amazon Lex V2 bots. |
| [CustomGPT](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/customgpt/) | Register CustomGPT agents. |
| [Dialogflow CX](https://docs.genguardx.ai/integrations/agent-studios/dialogflow-cx/) | Register Google Cloud Dialogflow CX agents. |
